description: Update a single existing expense row's category, tag, merchant or business purpose (e.g. 'recategorize expense X to Meals', 'tag it Client – Acme'). Identify it only by the exact expenseId from search_expenses (the full Receipt ID from Column Q); never a date, displayed number or sheet row number. Two-phase: calls with confirm omitted/false return a current→proposed preview and change nothing; after user confirmation, confirm:true applies it. If the expense is not found, search once for a current exact expenseId; never retry the same stale ID. If a business-purpose update exceeds the Notes capacity, stop and send the user to https://www.expensebot.ai/review-expenses?source=mcp. fields.paidWith edits only the optional Paid with bookkeeping label (no status/settlement change; blank clears it); reuse expectedPaidWith from the preview on confirm. Amounts, dates and raw notes require Review Expenses. Does not create or delete rows. Same change on several rows or attendees: correct_expenses; leave rows out: omit_expenses.

confirm.description: Omit or false = preview only (no write). Must be exactly true to apply the change.

expenseId.description: Exact full Receipt ID from Column Q, returned as expenseId by search_expenses.

fields.description: Partial update object. Include one or more of these optional keys; omit every field that should remain unchanged.

paidWith.description: Nickname, at most last4. Use alone; empty clears override.

name: update_expense
